title: Licking while cutting the throat
literal_meaning: Keep licking; from behind, keep cutting the throat.
meaning_odia: ଶବ୍ଦାର୍ଥରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପଟେ ଚାଟିବା, ଅନ୍ୟ ପଟେ ପଛରୁ ଗଳା କାଟିବା। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଚାଟିବା ଏଠାରେ ତୋଷାମଦର ଚିତ୍ର; ତାହା ସହ ଗୁପ୍ତରେ କ୍ଷତି କରିବାର ବିରୋଧ ରହିଛି। ମିଠା ବ୍ୟବହାର ଦେଖାଇ ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ କରୁଥିବା ଆଚରଣକୁ କଥାଟି ବିଦ୍ରୂପ କରୁଛି।
explanation: The first line offers the image of licking; the next reveals a throat being cut from behind. Read figuratively, the contrast exposes fawning behaviour that conceals betrayal. The repeated imperative sounds like a bitter accusation: the apparent friendliness and the hidden harm belong to the same conduct.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone repeatedly praises a colleague while secretly undermining that colleague’s work. On discovering the contradiction, a friend quotes this couplet.
cultural_context: The rhyme ଚାଟୁଥା / କାଟୁଥା brings two sharply opposed actions close together in sound. The phrase ପଛରୁ gives the second action its concealed, treacherous character.
